entries.blurb: Learn what 3D reconstruction is and how neural reconstruction works.
AI agents are advanced AI systems designed to autonomously reason, plan, and execute complex tasks based on high-level goals in a secure environment with controls.
An AI factory is a specialized computing infrastructure designed for the entire AI life cycle.
Learn how an AI grid distributes AI infrastructure across regions to balance performance, cost, and latency while routing workloads securely and efficiently.
AI inference helps solve advanced application deployment challenges by bringing machine learning and artificial intelligence technology to the real world.
AI infrastructure is designed to support the development, deployment, and management of AI models and applications.
AI reasoning is how AI systems analyze and solve problems by evaluating various outcomes and selecting the best solution, similar to human decision-making.
AI training is the process of teaching models to learn patterns from data, enabling reasoning, problem-solving, and content generation beyond explicit programming.
Learn all about AI Radio Access Networks (AI-RAN) and how they transform 6g mobile networks with AI.
AlphaFold2 is a machine learning model developed by Google DeepMind in 2020 to accurately predict 3D protein structures from amino acid sequences.
Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence (AI) that uses algorithms or statistical models to automatically learn experiences without explicit programming or human intervention.
Apache Spark is an open-source framework for processing big data tasks in parallel across clustered computers.
Automatic speech recognition (ASR) is the combination of processes and software that decode human speech and convert it to digitized text.
AI-driven systems that analyze telemetry, predict issues, simulate changes in digital twins, and continuously optimize multi-vendor network operations with minimal human input.
A robotaxi is a fully driverless, on-demand ride-hailing autonomous vehicle that operates at SAE Level 4 autonomy, navigating passengers or goods safely without a human driver present.
BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) is a deep learning model developed by Google for NLP pre-training and fine-tuning.
Chain of Thought (CoT) is a prompt engineering technique that helps large language models (LLMs) reason more accurately.
Cluster analysis is the grouping of objects based on their characteristics such that there is high intra-cluster similarity and low inter-cluster similarity.
As a sub-group of AI and deep learning, computer vision trains convolutional neural networks to develop human-like vision capabilities for applications.

A convolutional neural network (CNN) is a type of deep learning network used primarily to identify and classify images and to recognize objects within images. This deep learning network delivers the best results for mapping image data and has high computational efficiency.
Dask is an open source flexible library for parallel and distributed computing in Python.
A data flywheel is a feedback loop where data collected from interactions or processes is used to continuously refine AI models, which in turn generates better outcomes and more valuable data.
Deep agents are AI agents built for complex, long-running tasks. Learn how explicit planning, persistent memory, and subagent delegation power autonomous workflows.
Deep learning is a machine learning method and subset of artificial intelligence (AI). It uses artificial neural networks to recognize patterns in data, similar to the way the human brain operates.
Digital twins are virtual representations of products, processes, and facilities that enterprises use to design, simulate, and operate their physical counterparts.
Embodied AI refers to the integration of artificial intelligence into physical systems, enabling them to interact with the physical world.
Energy efficiency refers to a system or device’s ability to use as little energy as possible to perform a particular task or function within acceptable limits.
Frontier AI models are the most advanced general-purpose models, enabling reasoning, multimodal generation, and agentic workflows with optimized performance.
Generative AI enables users to quickly generate new content based on a variety of inputs. Learn all about the benefits, applications, challenges & more.
Graph analytics is a package for the Python programming language that’s used to create, manipulate, and study the structure, dynamics, and functions of complex networks.
HPC computer systems are characterized by their high-speed processing power, high-performance networks, and large-memory capacity.
Humanoids are general-purpose, bipedal robots modeled after the human form factor and designed to work alongside humans to augment productivity.
Imitation learning is a machine learning approach in which an agent learns to perform tasks or acquire new skills by observing and mimicking demonstrations provided by an expert.
Industrial AI is a critical enabler of industrial automation, enhancing the ability of machines, systems, and processes to operate with minimal human intervention.
K-means is a clustering algorithm—one of the simplest and most popular unsupervised machine learning (ML) algorithms for data scientists.
Kubernetes is an open-source orchestration platform for managing workloads and services encapsulated in software containers.
Large language models (LLMs) are deep learning algorithms that can recognize, summarize, translate, predict, and generate content using very large datasets.
Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence (AI) that uses algorithms or statistical models to automatically learn experiences without explicit programming or human intervention.
A set of practices and principles that aims to streamline the development, deployment, and maintenance of machine learning (ML) models in production environments.
MIP is a powerful tool widely used in operations research and decision science to solve complex optimization problems.
Discover the Mixture of Transformers (MoT) architecture, a unified system for efficient multimodal AI. Learn how MoT provides conditional computation for scalable foundation models.
Multi-agent systems are a collection of specialized AI agents that work together to solve a complex problem. Also known as teams of agents.
NLP is a technology that leverages computers and software to derive meaning from human language.
NetworkX is a package for the Python programming language that’s used to create, manipulate, and study the structure, dynamics, and functions of complex networks.
Numba is an open-source, just-in-time compiler for Python code that developers can use to accelerate numerical functions on both CPUs and GPUs using standard Python functions.
NumPy is a free, open-source Python library for n-dimensional array processing and numerical computing.
Define omni-models (multimodal AI) & how NVIDIA platforms like Cosmos and Nemotron power their use in agentic and physical AI applications.
Pandas is an open-source software library built on Python for data analysis and data manipulation.
Physical AI enables autonomous machines to perceive, understand, and perform complex actions in the real (physical) world.
Polars is an open-source DataFrame library for data manipulation and analysis. It is implemented in Rust and uses Apache Arrow’s columnar memory format for efficient data processing.
Power efficiency is the maximization of how much computing work and data movement is accomplished per unit of electricity consumed.
A product configurator is a visualization tool that allows users to customize products in real time.
PyTorch is a fully featured framework for building deep learning models, which is a type of machine learning.
Quantum computing is a paradigm shifting technology that leverages the laws of quantum physics to solve extremely difficult problems.

Random forests, or random decision forests, are supervised classification algorithms that use a learning method consisting of a multitude of decision trees. The output is the consensus of the best answer to the problem.
Reasoning VLA (vision-language-action) is a unified artificial intelligence model that integrates visual perception, language understanding, and action generation with step-by-step reasoning.
A recommendation system is an artificial intelligence or AI algorithm, usually associated with machine learning.
Linear and logistic regression are techniques for determining how a dependent variable is affected by one or more independent variables.
Reinforcement learning (RL) is a type of machine learning technique that enables robots to make intelligent decisions by learning from experience.
RAG enhances large language model prompts with relevant data for more practical, accurate responses. Learn all about the architecture and more.
Robot learning is a collection of algorithms and methodologies that help a robot learn new skills such as manipulation, locomotion, and more.
scikit-learn is a widely used open-source library in the Python ecosystem, designed specifically for machine learning-related tasks.
Sensor simulation replicates real-world sensor behavior, enabling safe AI training, testing, and validation for robotics, automotive, and industrial use.
Sentiment analysis is the automated interpretation and classification of emotions from textual data such as written reviews and social media posts.
SimReady, or “simulation-ready,” refers to a standard for physically accurate 3D assets that incorporate real-world properties, behaviors, and data bindings (e.g., IoT).
Hit identification, also known as hit finding or hit discovery, is the process of discovering small drug-like molecules that can potentially bind to a specific biological target.
Spatial computing merges digital data with the physical world in real time, enhancing mixed-reality interactions through devices like AR and VR headsets or smart glasses.
Learn about specialized AI, the industries it serves, the types of models it uses, and how it works.
Speech AI is a subset of conversational AI and includes automatic speech recognition (ASR) for converting spoken language into text and text-to-speech (TTS).
Stream processing is the continuous processing of new data events as they are received.
The process of creating text, 2D or 3D images in the visual and non-visual spectrum from computer simulations, generative AI models, or a combination of the two.
TensorFlow is the world’s most popular open-source library designed for developing and deploying state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms.
Text-to-speech is a form of speech synthesis that converts any string of text characters into spoken output.
A vector database is an organized collection of vector embeddings that can be created, read, updated, and deleted at any point in time.
A computational technique used in drug discovery to evaluate large libraries of small molecules or compounds to identify potential drug candidates.
Vision Language Models (VLMs) are multimodal generative AI models capable of reasoning over text, image and video prompts.

A world action model (WAM) is a robotics AI model that jointly predicts future world states and robot actions using video pretraining. Learn how WAMs enable zero-shot generalization, cross-embodiment transfer, and real-time control.
World models are neural networks that understand the dynamics of the real world, including physics and spatial properties.

XGBoost is an open-source software library that implements machine learning algorithms under the Gradient Boosting framework. XGBoost is growing in popularity and used by many data scientists globally to solve problems in regression, classification, ranking, and user-defined prediction challenges.
